 East Carolina vs Charlotte Preview
 East Carolina square off against Charlotte at Jerry Richardson Stadium, with kickoff scheduled for 10:00 on Saturday, November 14.
 East Carolina Pirates claimed a home victory in their previous game. A 20-17 triumph against South Florida Bulls at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium made it back-to-back wins.
 Charlotte 49ers have now lost four consecutive times at home. In their last game, they were beaten 23-12 on the road by UAB Blazers at Protective Stadium.
 H2H: East Carolina Won Previous H2H Clash
 The scoreline was 48-22 in favor of East Carolina when they last played Charlotte, with the matchup taking place at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium. In the past 3 H2H meetings, Charlotte have won two.
